name: Healthcare Practice Management: Book patient's chosen reschedule time
description: Every 30 minutes during the day, reads replies to approved cancellation reschedule offers (Microsoft 365 practices). When the patient clearly picks one of the offered times, re-checks it is still free in Cliniko, books it, confirms by replying to their email and closes the WorkQ item. Unclear replies, taken times, booking errors and offers with no reply after 7 days go back to the WorkQ item for a person.
